candidate.user_input: Who is responsible for handling the onboarding of temporary service providers according to the temporary service provider internal handbook page?
candidate.reference: The Procurement team is responsible for handling the onboarding of temporary service providers, as the People team is not involved in this process.
reference_contexts:
### Temporary Service Provider (Contractor/Consultant) Onboarding

The People team is not involved in the process for hiring, onboarding, or offboarding temporary service providers. You can work with the Procurement team on these onboardings and review the [temporary service provider internal handbook page](https://internal.gitlab.com/handbook/it/end-user-services/access-request/temporary-service-providers/) for templates and other helpful information.

source_conditions: The People team is not involved in the process for hiring, onboarding, or offboarding temporary service providers.
The Procurement team handles onboarding of temporary service providers.
